clusters.mechanism: Blanket redactGateData over the whole RunState also rewrites operational strings such as gate commands and phase, so a restored run executes different commands or skips pipeline phases.
Redacting stdout before onStdoutLine alters the trusted sandbox startup token, so runSandboxed fails to recognize it and throws a confinement error.

The streaming redaction cut-adjustment loop retreats across overlapping credential matches back to zero, so the pending buffer is unbounded and is rescanned repeatedly, causing memory growth and CPU blocking.
redactGateData identifies gate results only by ok and output keys, so unrelated objects get a fabricated confinementError field (and have strings altered).
Redaction is applied in many places beyond the single gate-result point (HTTP, SSE, artifacts, prompts, state), which is out of scope, changes data and formatting, and exceeds the line budget.
loadOutputPrivacy withholds any string containing the literal "[redacted]", hiding already-redacted MCP and digest text.
stdout and stderr are redacted separately before being joined, so a multiline credential spanning the join stays intact in the combined output.
The deploy CLI never calls loadConfig, so the credential registry is empty and deploy gate redaction does nothing.
The new stdoutTruncated and stderrTruncated ProcResult fields are unused by source, which is unrequested churn.
confinementError is now always written to GateResult rather than only when true, changing the persisted format.
